name: Taigam, Master Opportunist
clause: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, copy it, then exile the spell you cast with four time counters on it. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend.

needs.proposedSignature: widen `copy-spell` to `{ op: 'copy-spell'; target: TargetSpec | Ref; newTargets?: boolean }` so `target: 'triggering'` copies the spell a `cast` trigger was about, with no target requirement emitted by legal.ts.
needs.semantics: 'Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, copy it' copies the triggering spell, already bound in the frame as `triggering`. `copy-spell` (src/cards/types.ts:270) accepts only a TargetSpec, so the only way to write it today is to ask for a fresh spell target — a different card. docs/vocabulary/composition.md section 4 lists the ops widened to take a Ref; `copy-spell` is not among them.
needs.clause: Whenever you cast your second spell each turn, copy it, …

needs.proposedSignature: `{ op: 'suspend-object', what: Ref | TargetSpec, counters: Amount, grantSuspend?: true, from?: 'stack' | 'battlefield' | 'graveyard' | 'hand' }` — exile the named object with `counters` time counters and, with `grantSuspend`, give it suspend if it doesn't have it, so the two exile-zone triggers of CR 702.62a apply to it.
needs.semantics: Delay and Taigam suspend a card that never had suspend printed on it: the spell leaves the stack to exile with N time counters and gains the keyword. Today `counter` can only send the card to exile bare (`toExile`), `move` can add `withCounters: { counter: 'time', … }` but the counters are inert, and no op grants a keyword to a card outside the battlefield.
needs.clause: If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend.
